aggregationMethod: Read completed immutable proposals, independent verifier plans/file lists, application reports and recovery/capsule receipts; authenticate small receipt chains, compare exact approved path/hash/metadata/count/byte sets, confirm selected source absence; stat retained archive and journal allocations. No archive stream re-verification or compiler execution.

limitations: Allocated values use current st_blocks*512 for retained files/directories; payload bytes are not block allocation. Existing capsules in the first tranche predated this work and are not charged again.
Net file/directory accounting is distinct from observed free-space deltas, which include other writers, filesystem effects and receipt timing. No current-free snapshot is a target admission promise.

Original source inode identities are preserved in evidence, not recreated by restore. Maintained restore reconstructs exact member bytes, owner/group where permitted, mode and mtime at original paths by default, refusing changed existing content.
Restore commands allocate the original data again; reserve space first and use a fresh output journal. --member can restrict a restore.
Historical raw evidence became cold, not discarded: archive, receipt, independent verified plan and apply journal remain. CurrentPhase174/rollback/runtime/source/profile inputs stayed hot.
